environment: Original Arc application, running locally in an isolated development environment with a real backend and synthetic records.
revisionNote: The intervening changes concern delivery, CI, documentation and test timing. The reviewed product UI and domain implementation are equivalent.

datasets.portfolioExplorer: Northstar Learning: two schools, three classes and 66 fictional learners. Named learner views show a six-person sample.
datasets.originalBiCaptures: A separate synthetic reporting cohort: three schools, five classes, five instructors, 66 learners, 25 completed lesson runs and 892 submission versions (800 submitted and 92 drafts). This normal-data-path cohort exists only in the isolated SQLite capture database.
datasets.originalLearningCaptures: Earlier synthetic learning/classroom accounts remain separate from the new BI cohort. They demonstrate themes, task work, feedback and instructor panels.
datasets.comparison: The 30-day BI view includes five eligible peers; the separately captured seven-day view does not. The native comparison gate and absolute values remain visible.

boundaries: These are original application pixels with fictional records, not a recording of the portfolio explorer.
Sample counts are not production analytics. The 3,000+ audience claim elsewhere refers to Arc and Browser Coder combined.
Some learning-friction denominators count learner-run pairs rather than unique people.
VRI includes a fixed 0.8 stability assumption. Operational indices are modeled signals, not causal educational outcomes or measured financial return.
No production accounts, private learner records or credentials are included.

films.title: The program behind the classroom.
films.description: Explore the original admin and scoped school analytics: inventory, nine friction lenses, an open calculation, modeled indices, a comparison gate and the work behind the numbers.

chapters.title: Inventory and activity
chapters.description: The original BI view separates all-time inventory from activity within the selected period. Every figure comes from fictional local fixtures.

chapters.title: Nine friction lenses
chapters.description: Nine distinct lenses show different participation and workflow patterns. Labels and calculation controls remain visible in the original interface.

chapters.title: Open the calculation
chapters.description: The native No-Show explanation opens. A close-up retains its formula, variables and concrete substitution: one qualifying run out of 25 gives 4%.

chapters.title: Read modeled indices carefully
chapters.description: The 30-day modeled-index view includes five eligible peers. Its VRI calculation includes a fixed 0.8 assumption; these indices are not validated causal measurements of teaching quality.

chapters.title: Respect the comparison gate
chapters.description: A separately loaded seven-day slice has no eligible peers. Arc retains absolute values and explicitly withholds a fair peer comparison; this differs from the 30-day view shown before it.

chapters.title: Review queues and grade context
chapters.description: The scoped school analytics view displays review age, score distribution and a class-by-lesson grade matrix. A detail insert makes the matrix values readable.

chapters.title: Follow lesson progression
chapters.description: Started, submitted and reviewed counts stay separate along the lesson sequence, followed by a weekly trend view. This is fictional history, not reported live program impact.

films.edit: Uniform source-pixel crops and Lanczos scaling, calm hard cuts, frame holds/time stretching, two detail inserts, and editorial captions outside the original UI. Every frame contains original interface pixels. No generated replacement UI, invented provider result, synthetic interaction or audio.
caveats: Different date windows are separate original views, not a filmed filter-change interaction.
Modeled indices contain assumptions and should not be treated as validated causal measurements.
Original fixture inventory is distinct from the code-native explorer fixture.
Native interface wording and incidental source display limitations are preserved.
